date.source: The report page is dated 9 July 2020 and gives no date for the show itself; the bulletin of 7 July 2020 says Hard Times is the next pay-per-view.

evidence.note: The pay-per-view report: seven matches each with a highlights paragraph and the winner named under 'Et le vainqueur est'; the names beside 'VS' were images and are not on the page, so only the matches whose sides the text names are entered.

matches.finish: Brutal Mondo dodged the Grand Carrefour, hit Hands of Storm and finished LG Cie with the Diving 'Slap' Elbow Drop.
matches.note: The page names the opposing team only as LG Cie.

matches.finish: Lilith opened what seemed the door to hell and M Cube grabbed her and threw himself in with her; the door closed and the match was declared a draw.
matches.note: A single match that began backstage.

matches.finish: Ashley Diamond pinned La Torche after Amalia Perez hit her finisher.
matches.note: Magnum made the change to La Torche; the page names Magnum by first name only.

matches.finish: Kevin Cyd pushed the Influencer to the mat by a finger on the chest and pinned him; Magic Booya could not believe it.

matches.stipulation: Single match for the AMC title
matches.finish: Destroyer seemed to win, but it was a kick-out by Akira; Destroyer called for his allies, none came, and Akira hit his finisher and won; the champion celebrated with the title.

date.source: The full card, posted before the show, sets the event for Friday 19 June at 20:00 French time; the report is of that event (June 2020).

evidence.note: The pay-per-view report in four posts narrated by the commentators Bob Bobby and Jimmy Stallion: six matches in order, each ending with the winner named under 'Et le vainqueur est'.
The full card of D-Day, with the date and time and the six matches.

matches.finish: Akira Yamashita won by pinfall after a long match in which Oliver Shock kicked out of several covers.
AMC won by disqualification; the Hell Legion kept beating AMC afterwards.
matches.note: Listed on the card as Lilith v AMC.
The commentators call it a match where the two smashed each other.

matches.stipulation: Single match, Double J guest referee
matches.finish: Ashley Diamond was declared the winner to the crowd's jeers and afterwards took off a referee's outfit and threw it on Double J.

matches.note: Kevin Cyd threw his campaign leaflets on Kween Kool afterwards.

matches.stipulation: Single match for the Universe Championship
matches.finish: Destroyer won and became the first Universe Champion; the Hell Legion then attacked the dazed M Cube.
matches.note: The main event; the commentators say the winner would be the first Universe Champion in the federation's history.
